meta.what_this_is: eWAR v3: the frozen published fWAR vintage plus named departures, each zero-sum per season and side. The headline eWAR carries the ABS part (owner override EW3-32, 2026 on); eWAR realized adds the realized pitching basis R2 (2016 on). A player-season not listed here carries fWAR unchanged on both series.
